protocol.scope: New Lead-I-only feasibility study authorized by user; original all-lead pilot stays complete and failed its own gate

extractor.fidelity: independent 10-second adaptation; exact paper implementation unverified

emd.failure: Reject capped/invalid output; preserve failure and continue other declared pilot tasks. No automatic larger cap or patient replacement.

analytic.implementation: scipy.signal.hilbert native length, no additional extension
analytic.frequency: unwrap phase; numpy.gradient dt=1/fs edge_order=2; signed Hz without clipping
analytic.component_means: frequency mean over valid samples; envelope mean over all retained samples
analytic.global_frequency: instantaneous energy-weighted frequency over valid components, then time mean
analytic.global_envelope: instantaneous root-sum-square of all component envelopes, then time mean
analytic.geometry: sum of four trimmed analytic signals; exact continuous arc-length centroid of open piecewise-linear path; zero-length edges zero weight

cohort.method: Choose distinct fit patients and one record each by SHA256 ranks, without labels. Separate hash ranking assigns 512 internal-evaluation patients; first 512 hash-ranked remaining model-fit patients form engineering stage.

gate.rationale: Prospective engineering usability threshold allowing at most 5/512 engineering failures; not a clinical requirement or guarantee. Complete all declared engineering cases; no cap increase or patient replacement. Do not start evaluation feature extraction/model scoring if engineering or model-fit gate fails.

failure_policy.extractor: Reject capped or invalid features; preserve numerical failure, timing, input identity and traces. No imputation of feature vectors.
failure_policy.fit: Fit scaler and classifier only on numerically successful model-fit rows; list every omitted fit record and class counts. No patient replacement.
failure_policy.evaluation: Keep every selected evaluation patient in primary metrics. On extraction failure use the original selected model-fit cohort prevalence as an explicitly flagged fallback probability. Also report extraction coverage by class and covered-only metrics. Do not describe fallback as a classifier-produced ECG score.

shared.scaler: StandardScaler fitted on successful model-fit rows only

perturbations.seed_assignment: seed_base plus index in record-id-sorted evaluation cohort; same existing perturbations function generates both noise arrays and crop
perturbations.comparisons: clean vs each variant: AP/sensitivity changes, probability shifts, threshold label flips and per-class coverage; evaluate both logistic representations

evaluation.primary_contrast: full_geometry minus without_geometry AP on clean evaluation signals
evaluation.bootstrap_unit: patient, paired across all arms and perturbations
evaluation.uncertainty: pointwise percentile intervals conditional on selected cohort and fitted models; exclude retraining uncertainty; resample failures too
evaluation.label: Exploratory internal holdout wholly inside original fit patients; no direct ranking against models evaluated on original validation cohort

execution.checkpoint: per-record terminal outcomes, per-stage markers, saved models/predictions and hashed final completion
